name: eol-time
description: Log hours, run your timer, submit your week, log expenses and work the approval queue in EOL Time (time.eol.agency, EOL's Harvest replacement) from Claude: the EOL Time MCP server plus five skills.

api_key.title: EOL Time API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://time.eol.agency/settings/api-keys. A key starting eol_time_ can only track and submit your own time (recommended); one starting eol_full_ can do everything you can in EOL Time, which expenses and approvals need.
